name: Internal CLI
tagline: A single onboarding-to-deploy CLI that replaced a wiki page of copy-pasted shell commands.

seo.title: Internal CLI — Martin Zachariassen
seo.description: A single onboarding-to-deploy CLI, built in Rust, that replaced a wiki page of copy-pasted shell commands.

cover.alt: A terminal session running dev up, dev deploy --local and dev doctor, each completing in under twenty seconds.
cover.caption: One command instead of a wiki page.

summary: New engineers spent their first week running commands copied from a wiki page that was out of date as often as not. I built a single CLI covering environment setup, local services and deploys, versioned alongside the infrastructure it drove so it could never drift from what the wiki described.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: One command instead of a wiki page

blocks.value: Time to a first local build for a new engineer went from roughly a day of following stale instructions to under twenty minutes, and the tool itself became the source of truth the wiki page used to be.
